It looks like you forgot to paste your manuscript! Right now, all I have to go on is the title: **"Chapter 2: The Ground Truth Problem."** 

As someone who doesn't normally read fantasy or *isekai* (parallel world/reincarnation) stories, I will say that the title alone sounds sharp and cerebral—it hints at an intriguing mystery or an analytical protagonist, which already piques my curiosity more than a generic high-fantasy title might.

Whenever you're ready, please paste the actual chapter text! Once you do, I’ll dive in and review it specifically through the eyes of a newcomer:

* **Clarity & Lore Accessibility:** Did I understand what was happening, or did I drown in unexplained magical jargon and world-building?
* **Cognitive Load:** Was the flow intuitive, or did I have to stop and re-read paragraphs to figure out the rules of the world?
* **Relatable Human Conflict:** Beyond the fantasy tropes, did the character's emotions, dilemmas, and stakes feel real and grounded?
* **The Hook:** Did it make me want to keep reading Chapter 3, even though this isn't my usual genre?

Drop the text in whenever you're ready!
